$comment: Demo evidence for the fixture verifier. THIS IS NOT A PROOF.
It stands in for the output of a ZK Email proof so the rest of the
pipeline — attestor policy, nullifier derivation, canonical signing,
Compact redemption, replay rejection — can be run and demonstrated before

when MAILPROOF_ALLOW_FIXTURE_VERIFIER=1 is set explicitly, reports
cryptographicVerification: false on /health, and says so on startup.
Never present a run backed by this file as a live proof (§50.4).
The values mirror the synthetic demo email in Appendix H.
